name: Malabar spinach

schedule.notes: Soak seed 24 hours; nick the hard coat to speed germination.
Wait for warm soil and reliably warm nights. Set near a 6 ft trellis.
Pinch leafy tips and young stems. The more you pick, the more it produces.

harvest.cues: Leaves thick, glossy, succulent; pick before flowering for best texture. Both green-stem and red-stem cultivars exist.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge in damp paper 5 to 7 days. Mucilaginous when cooked (thickens like okra) — good in stews.

varieties.name: Red-stem Malabar
varieties.notes: Striking red stems and green leaves. Slightly stronger flavor.

varieties.name: Green Malabar
varieties.notes: All green. Milder, more spinach-like flavor.

notes: The hot-summer spinach substitute — thrives when regular spinach has long bolted. Vines climb 6 ft+. Doubles as an ornamental on a fence or arbor.
